patient_message.content: Do I need a referral for a specialist, and do I need one for a dentist?

assistant_message.content:
Hi there,

To answer your questions: you don't need a referral to book a visit with any of our practitioners, including specialists, so you can go ahead and book directly. The same applies to dentists — no referral is needed there either, and you can book a visit with a dentist directly as well.

Let me know if you have any other questions!
